title: 基本计算器 II
summary: 计算只含非负整数、加减乘除和空格的有效表达式，整数除法向零截断。
insight: 延迟处理当前运算符后的数字；加减把带符号数累加，乘除立即作用于上一项即可实现优先级。
pitfalls: 最后一个数字也要在扫描末尾结算
除法使用语言的整数向零截断语义

solutions.title: 累计结果与最后一项
solutions.idea: result 保存已确定的加减项，last 保存尚可被乘除修改的最近项。
steps: 遇运算符或末尾时按 previousOperator 结算
加减把旧 last 加入 result，最终返回 result+last

code.java: class Solution { public int calculate(String s){int result=0,last=0,number=0;char operator='+';for(int i=0;i<s.length();i++){char c=s.charAt(i);if(Character.isDigit(c))number=number*10+c-'0';if((!Character.isDigit(c)&&c!=' ')||i==s.length()-1){if(operator=='+'){result+=last;last=number;}else if(operator=='-'){result+=last;last=-number;}else if(operator=='*')last*=number;else last/=number;operator=c;number=0;}}return result+last;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun calculate(s:String):Int{var result=0;var last=0;var number=0;var operator='+';for(i in s.indices){val c=s[i];if(c.isDigit())number=number*10+(c-'0');if((!c.isDigit()&&c!=' ')||i==s.lastIndex){when(operator){'+'->{result+=last;last=number};'-'->{result+=last;last=-number};'*'->last*=number;'/'->last/=number};operator=c;number=0}};return result+last} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int calculate(string s){int result=0,last=0,number=0;char op='+';for(int i=0;i<(int)s.size();++i){char c=s[i];if(isdigit(c))number=number*10+c-'0';if((!isdigit(c)&&c!=' ')||i==(int)s.size()-1){if(op=='+'){result+=last;last=number;}else if(op=='-'){result+=last;last=-number;}else if(op=='*')last*=number;else last/=number;op=c;number=0;}}return result+last;} };
